newsitem.title: UK: Quintain says to sell parts of Fiscal Prop.
newsitem.headline: Quintain says to sell parts of Fiscal Prop.

text.p: Britain's Quintain Estates and Development Plc announced on Thursday it was planning to sell a significant portion of Fiscal Properties Plc which it had bought three months ago.
The portfolio is being sold to Fieldmore Holdings Ltd, a private company controlled by foreign investors, for 79.5 million stg.
Fieldmore had paid an initial deposit of 3.975 million stg, which is repayable if shareholder consent for the transaction is not obtained at its extraordinary general meeting next month.
The disposal is expected improve Quintain's gearing to less than 50 percent from 115 percent.
